title: Boon
summary: BOON, noun [Latin bonus.] 1. A gift; a grant; a benefaction; a present; a favor granted. 2. A prayer, or petition. BOON, adjective [Latin bonus.] Gay; merry; kind; bountiful; as a boon companion.
